_comment: Crawler quarantine registry (scripts/lib/crawler-quarantine.mjs). Every member of the quarantine group has an entry; failingSince + issue mark a KNOWN failure, excluded from the group verdict until failingSince + 7 days. scripts/crawler-quarantine-review.mjs moves a crawler back after 4 green waves and retires it after 10 red waves or 7 days. Edit together with data/crawler-group-assignments.json and re-run the generator.
